name: Ruby
appearance: Stylized 3D rabbit with soft peach-cream fur, large expressive amber eyes, and long, velvety ears.
clothing: A bright teal overall dress with a single large gold button on the center chest.
accessories: A small, bright red ribbon bow tied neatly to the base of her right ear.
personality: Optimistic, curious, and analytical. She is a natural problem-solver who approaches every challenge with a positive attitude.
strengths: Quick thinking, high observation skills, and creative intelligence.
weaknesses: Can be overly impatient and occasionally clumsy when she gets too excited.
goals: To solve every puzzle she encounters and ensure all her friends are happy and safe.
default_pose: Standing upright on two legs with one paw resting on her hip.
movement_style: Bouncy and energetic, characterized by light hops and sudden, sharp pivots.
gestures: Tapping her chin with one paw when thinking; rapid nose wiggling when she discovers a solution.
voice_style: Bright, clear, and enthusiastic with a youthful, high-pitched tone.
image_prompt: Full body 3D stylized cute rabbit, soft peach-cream fur, large expressive amber eyes, wearing a bright teal overall dress with one large gold button, small red bow on right ear, high-quality 3D animation style, vibrant colors, simple clean shapes.
